report_name: Warwickshire Local Cycling and Walking Infrastructure Plan
other_tools_used: Walking, Cycling and Horse-Riding Assessment and Review (WCHAR)
other_tools_developed: The document mentions the use of a 'Route Selection Tool', 'Walking Route Audit Tool', 'Cycling Level of Service', 'Healthy Streets Design Check England', 'Active Mode Appraisal Toolkit', 'Health Equity Assessment Tool (HEAT)', 'Cycling Infrastructure Prioritisation Toolkit (CyIPT)', and a 'Cycle Audit' developed by Warwickshire County Council.
specific_evidence_of_impact: The 2018 Cycling Infrastructure Task and Finish Group Report led to an ambitious programme of capital investment in cycling improvements, and the 2021 Commonplace survey and 2022 LCWIP consultation feedback were used to update the LCWIP and develop network proposals.
